item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
My humble apologies for not seeing your PM soon enough. I suppose it's never too late for a quick review, even when the article is posted.

I suppose it is fair to situate this article as the first postwar encounter between IJAMEA and GRU-P. That being said, I think it can benefit from a bit more unique detail. You have referenced quite a number of things that tie in with RL, which I can appreciate. But since this is a work in a setting full of the supernatural, I think this article lacks a more overt mentioning of anomalies.

Perhaps the IJAMEA of that time has almost no anomalies. However, GRU-P would have anomalies and I suppose IJAMEA being subjected to GRU-P's horrors would be better than subtle hints that may or may not anomalous.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Thanks to kakroom and Modern Erasmus for looking over this!

This is my first GOI formatted articles, and probably the beginning of an exploration of the relationship between the GRU-"P" and IJAMEA, and the various different groups of interests involved within that relationship.
